caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic beer stein with a large handle on the right side, positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The stein is predominantly light tan in color with subtle shading to suggest its rounded form. A blue-gray hue is used to represent the empty interior of the stein, visible at the top. There is a decorative graphic on the side of the stein: in reddish-brown ink, it features three figures standing, all dressed in clothing suggestive of a historical or colonial period. Additional elements include an emblem or seal to the left of the figures, above which a person appears to be holding an object. Below the figures is a banner-like design with partially legible text, "BREWING IN AMERICA," in capital letters. The bottom of the drawing contains faint handwritten script, including the words "Mug of Charles Longo..." and a partially visible date, "1933." The composition is sparse, with the mug isolated against the neutral background and no other objects present.
title: Stoneware Mug for Beer
